justification: Both surfaces depict upright anthropomorphic figures with raised arms holding small objects, and both include radiating/rosette-like and circular motifs, but these are generic correspondences. A is a scattered field of tiny stick-figures, boats and cup-like signs with no ground line, while B is a single large, densely detailed bird-headed winged figure in profile beside a formal stylised tree with a text band above; the depictive conventions (schematic linear silhouettes vs. anatomically modelled, feather-by-feather relief) share nothing distinctive.
